## Governance and lifecycle records

| Document ID / version | Template and revision | Sources / related records | Review evidence | Supersedes / replacement | Retention rule | Archive location | Disposition approval / record |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [ID / version] | [Reference] | [References and versions] | [Checks / reviewer / date] | [Reference, if any] | [Rule reference] | [Location] | [Required authority / pending / completed record] |

A saved attachment hash identifies a snapshot, not necessarily the latest
published document. Keep source, published and archive locations distinct.
Before moving or disposing of a record, check required approvals, retention
rules, applicable holds and references that depend on it. Preserve the history
and disposition evidence required by the established policy.
